Southern Power, a wholly owned subsidiary of the holding company Southern Company, is not identified as an NRC licensee. Consequently, Southern Power's $29 million net income decrease in 2024 (down to $328 million) was driven by other factors, including increased scheduled outage and maintenance expenses, the non-recurrence of a prior-year arbitration award, and a prior-year gain on the sale of spare parts. The disclosed arbitration award is treated as a discrete, non-recurring prior-year benefit and is not linked to NRC regulatory obligations.
